path_signature.inference_rule: Expected direction is negative. planned_path.path_summary: Use all authorized observations with smd or pr election-rule coding and estimate whether SMD elections have a lower median Manifesto-method plurality-winner distance from the median voter than PR elections.

path_signature.sample_restriction: Rows in the authorized dataset with smd coded as smd or pr and nonmissing required focal variables.
path_signature.missing_data_rule: Listwise deletion for pldist1, smd, and year.

path_signature.inference_rule: Expected direction is negative. execution_result.status_reason: The agent followed the planned Task1 path exactly: authorized Stata data, pldist1 outcome, SMD-versus-PR contrast, listwise deletion for required variables, and median quantile regression. No repairs or implementation deviations were required.

planned_path.path_summary: Use all authorized observations with smd/pr election-rule coding and estimate whether SMD elections have a lower expected Manifesto-method plurality-winner distance from the median voter than PR elections using a Gamma GLM with log link.

path_signature.inference_rule: Expected direction is negative for smd_bin.
